blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – A Filipino was killed in an intercepted drone strike in Saudi Arabia, the country’s Ministry of Energy reported on Thursday. According to the Saudi authority, a drone attempting to hit a Shaybah oil field was intercepted, killing two and wounding two more. “An official source at the Ministry of Energy stated that Saudi air defences intercepted a drone attempting to target a processing facility at Saudi Aramco’s Shaybah oil field in the Eastern Province on Wednesday morning,” the Ministry of Energy said in a statement.
